H01.bug: NODE0 advances directly to NODE2, skipping NODE1 in the token sequence.

H02.bug: NODE2 drives the wrong token bit, passing the token as if it were at NODE1.

H03.bug: Reset clears the received-token status instead of marking NODE0 as the initial recipient.

H04.bug: Data is sent when either the node has the token or data is ready, rather than requiring both conditions.

H05.bug: Reset starts the FSM at NODE1 instead of NODE0, misaligning the initial state with the reset token outputs.

H06.bug: Checks the token for the next node instead of the current node before sending data.

H07.bug: Skips NODE2 when advancing from NODE1.

H08.bug: Retains the previous data_out value instead of clearing it when the send condition is false.

H09.bug: Rotates the input bits before forwarding them to data_out.

H10.bug: Transmits data only when the data-ready signal is deasserted.
